purpose: Cached videos no reader can use: the container does not open, the footage stops decoding long before it ends, or it decodes with errors throughout. Loops read this (tools/guards.py footage_corrupt_reason) and give a chart on one of these videos a FOOTAGE_CORRUPT verdict instead of a PARK: no reader change rescues it and a rescan gives the same file. Only a fresh download does, which loops may not do - that is the owner's. `bands` null means every band of the video.
